judge.rationale: README.md amendment A2: judge held constant so the apply model is the only variable.

panel_escalation.trigger: apply models disagreed on case outcome

known_limitation: Single-family panel. Apply and judge are both Claude, so self-preference is undiluted (docs/judge-protocol.md, Lessons_learned.md -> judge biases). Reported as a coverage signal, not a calibrated number. A positive result would be the one to distrust; this round returned a null, which that bias does not manufacture.
score_delta_reason: Phase 0 is baseline-only. The pre-committed stop rule fired before any treatment arm was built, so there is no before/after pair to gate.
